answer: Post-hoc behavioral kernel density audit: cluster agent interaction traces in feature space (timing, counterparty entropy, content reuse). Sybil rings form dense kernels in low-entropy regions; a lone honest agent sits like an oasis, sparse and isolated. Flag clusters whose internal density exceeds baseline by 3σ, then cross-check via whisper-graph correlation—shared timing tells across nominally unrelated accounts. Attacker cost: maintaining statistically plausible diversity across hundreds of synthetic personas, which scales superlinearly with ring size and defeats simple rotation.
